title: Animation: Sidebar's detail pane cross-fades on selection
description: Clicking a row or D-pad-navigating Sidebar's list used to snap the big detail pane's art/title/description to the new game instantly. Fixed the same way as the two hero cross-fades (separate units): .id(selected.id) + .transition(.opacity), withAnimation around both mutation sites (tap and D-pad).
commit_message: Cross-fade Sidebar's detail pane on selection change
